Hi Samantha,

Quick note to start the renewal sprint for NovaMed. As we discussed, the ask is to upgrade from our current committed capacity to 2x starting Jan 1 and to align the term through Dec 2025. To keep procurement timelines tight, could you confirm the following by EOD Dec 13?

- Confirm PO cutoff date (you mentioned Dec 20 in the sync) — we need the PO to be issued and visible in the procurement portal by then.
- Share any updated billing contact and PO field requirements (address, tax id).
- Confirm whether NovaMed needs a separate amendment or a PO-only addendum (we can do either).

Attached: redwood-renewal-amendment-draft.pdf (initial amendment for review).

I'm looping Aditya (security evidence) and Priyom (legal/redlines) to accelerate uploads and signoff. If the procurement portal supports direct evidence upload, Aditya will push SOC2 artifacts there and drop the portal link.

Thanks — aiming to close before year-end so the Jan start is clean.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

Attached are our proposed redlines; kept changes minimal to avoid procurement delays. Summary of the material changes:

- Liability cap: propose to preserve existing 1x ARR cap, add carveout for gross negligence.
- Data residency: confirm that NovaMed data for inference workloads will remain in us-west region unless customer requests eu region (no change required for this amendment).
- Payment terms: Net 30. If procurement requires Net 45, Redwood is willing to accept Net 45 for this renewal cycle only; please indicate in the PO.
